items.q: Bobby Moore and I went to -- wait a minute, wait a minute, now. I'm trying to remember whether Bobby and I went to Pittsburgh together and joined the band

ctx.x: And Bobby Moore and I went to -- wait a minute, wait a minute, now. I'm trying to remember whether Bobby and I went to Pittsburgh together and joined the band, or whether he joined the band later on. It seems to me like maybe I went to Pittsburgh alone. Can't remember whether I caught a train, or a bus, or how I got there. I really don't remember that.
No. Well, somebody must have paid your ticket?
